title: Beautiful and refreshing!
text: It was hot on the Costa Brava thus heading out to the mountains with Jamie - and jumping into cold water pools! - was the right thing to do. Our family of four (two athletic adults and two kids, aged 8 and 11) had a great time on this hike. Great scenery, just the right level of exercise for us that day, and overall pleasant. We had decided from the get-go not to go all the way to the waterfall since we knew it would be too much for the kids. Jamie was knowledgeable, personable, had good stories to tell, and is all-around a great person to spend the day with. He also was very patient and quick
author: 274brigitteg

title: Totally worth it.
text: Amazing experience.  Jamie was a great guide and the hike was beautiful.  Jamie made traveling from Barcelona to Girano simple.  Highly recommended.

title: Gorgeous hike with amazing guide!
text: The hike was absolutely fantastic! My husband and I thoroughly enjoyed all of the scenery and Jamie was a wonderful guide! Extremely kind and thoughtful and very knowledgeable, and great to talk to. You cannot do better!
author: Z4615TVdaniellec

title: Great hiking trip
text: Nice day hike to a beautiful waterfall. Easy hiking trail along the river with a couple of stops to jump in and cool off. Jamie was excellent guide and knowledgeable about the local area and was able to give us recommendations for other trips during our stay. The trip went has planned and was well organized.
author: Danika S

title: Amazing family friendly experience
text: Jamie was so accommodating with our family of three young children all under the age of 6. This was such a highlight on our trip and I wish that we had time to do the rest of his adventures. We will certainly be back to do another hike with him.
author: cyrousa

title: Sunny day hike in autumn-colored Pyrenees
text:
It was a beautiful day of relaxed hiking in autumn-colored mountains. Jamie easily scaled up the difficulty of the route for me, but there were lots of options for different fitness levels. As it was late November, there were hardly any other people around, so we had all the scenery to ourselves, including the waterfall, where you can swim, if you are not afraid of somewhat chilly waters. I did, and it was fun.
After the hike Jamie dropped me off in Girona, advised on the main sights and good places to eat. So I ended up having two experiences in one day: the mountains and Girona.

author: Oleksandr R

title: Beautiful hike with a fantastic guide
text: I booked a private hike with Jamie and loved every bit of the experience! I was staying in Barcelona so he helped me find the right train and fetched me from the station. Considering how long the hike was and the driving back and forth from the station, the tour was incredibly good value for money. The hike itself was incredible, just so beautiful and Jamie definitely knew how to find the best routes and spots. He was super professional, but also laid-back, friendly and kind. It was great to chat to him but also when there were silences it was very comfortable and I didn't feel pressure at all
author: N2281JUjessd

title: Lovely day in the mountains 🥰
text:
I went to the Pyrenees on a private tour with Jamie. I had a wonderful day! Jamie knows his mountain so good and since summer is almost gone, we had the waterfall to ourselves :)
The weather was perfect for the hike, not too cold and not too hot. Getting to the meeting point from BCN was super easy.
author: 267dafnab

title: Breathtaking swim with wonderful views and a lovely guide
text: A beautiful experience, the highlight of my trip to Barcelona! The hike is relatively easy, the views and the forest are amazing and Jamie is very skilled at adjusting his pace to your needs and your tempo. During the hike we were able to swim in three different, absolutely wonderful spots. I must say what a positive experience it was spending a day with Jamie - I was initially worried about having a whole day and maybe not many common topics to talk about during the hike. I am now certain that whoever you are, you'll find a common ground with Jamie. This is definitely a great trip to take eve
